messages:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — we need a final decision on modular packs for next sprint. core ask: separate compute credits from QoS addons so customers can buy throughput/SLA independently. priority: avoid churn for existing commit customers and create a clean upsell path.
Jordan Patel: agree. Sales feedback: customers want simple packs: Commit + Perf Addon + Priority Lane. they dislike per-route knobs. can we make quoting one-line per addon? :thumbsup:
Devin Ortega: Draft pack shapes: Base = model access + basic rate limits; Performance Addon = reserved throughput + burst reservoir; Priority Lane = p95 latency SLA + routing priority + faster autoscale. define softfloor baseline per commit and a hard cap for burst.
Samira Khan: Note from Partnerships: resellers require a monthly addon line-item to bundle. AcmeHealth pilot asked for dedicated priority lane + on-prem commit discount. we should support negotiable multipliers in SOWs.
Lexi Rivera (Legal): Legal constraints: (1) SLA credits must have a liability cap, (2) we can't change pack economics mid-contract without 60d notice and customer opt-out, (3) reseller discounts must appear in SOW and cannot be backdated.
pricing-bot: quick sim (rough):
```
Base: $0.0008/token
Performance Addon: +$X/hr per reserved vGPU equiv
Priority Lane: +20% unit price OR +$Y/mo per route
Estimated uplift: 8-14% revenue, gross margin change 10-18% depending on mix
```
Jordan Patel: Sales preference = monthly fixed addon pricing for resellers, usage-based for self-serve. keeps quotes simple.
Devin Ortega: Billing model question for Priority Lane — fixed monthly fee vs per-request surcharge. fixed = easier to sell, per-use = aligned economics and prevents overcommit. tradeoffs?
Samira Khan: For pilots prefer fixed monthly fee to simplify budgeting. we can accept some margin loss to de-risk adoption.
Lexi Rivera (Legal): Contract language suggestions: add "No retroactive pricing adjustments for active commitments" and a change-control flow. set an aggregate cap on SLA credits per month (suggest max 10% of monthly committed fees).
Mia Chen: Proposed launch criteria for the addon packs pilot:
- Pilot cohort: 3 customers (1 reseller, 1 enterprise, 1 self-serve)
- KPI: Priority Lane p95 latency < 200ms
- KPI: Cost delta for chatbot workload < 15% vs baseline
- KPI: Pilot to paid conversion or documented feedback in < 90 days
- Ops: Console metrics + alerting + rollout playbook in place
Jordan Patel: Timeline suggestion: internal pilot next 2 weeks, customer pilots weeks 3-6, canary week 7, GA around week 9-10.
Devin Ortega: Implementation notes: need router policy updates, quota service changes, billing SKU additions. I'll open infra tickets after thread.
Samira Khan: Sales action: assemble 3 pilot customers + target commercial terms this week.
Lexi Rivera (Legal): I'll draft contract clauses for SLA caps and change-control. need concrete pricing ranges to finalize thresholds.
Mia Chen: Action items recap:
- Devin: infra + billing tickets + SKU draft (owner) — due EOW
- Jordan/Samira: pilot list + commercial terms — due in 3 days
- Lexi: contract clause draft — due in 4 days
- Pricing-bot/Product: run 3 workload sims with suggested numbers and share sensitivity table — due EOW
Thanks everyone — reconvene after artifacts. :rocket:
